wiki.title: Zack Maynard
wiki.extract: Zack Maynard (born March 29, 1992) is an American politician who served in the West Virginia House of Delegates from the 22nd district from 2016 to 2022. On October 30, 2025, Maynard was appointed by governor Patrick Morrisey to represent the 7th district of the West Virginia Senate to fill the vacancy caused by Michael B. Stuart's resignation.
